reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a thread under his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

That comes from the incident channel itself, which he's a member of. On 3 Sep 2025 Priyanka posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had unlabelled totes stacked beside door 4. Her resolution note later that day said Southgate had cleared the backlog.

I couldn't find a street address for Southgate, either in that channel or in any file Tobias can open, and I told him so in the reply.
